title: Let studios invite their accountant

comments.body: Post-deploy: health 200, invite smoke test passed.

body:
Studios invite their accountant by email.

Closes #12 · Plan: `docs/plans/v1/01-invite-accountant.md`

## Suggested follow-ups
1. Add a unit test for the leap-year branch of the date helper. If we skip it: a regression could pass CI.
2. Extract the duplicated currency formatting in the dashboard into a shared helper. If we skip it: the two copies may drift.
3. An accountant who opens an expired invite link sees a blank page. If we skip it: invited accountants cannot join, and studios email support every week.
